notes: The final path segment of pages_base is case-sensitive and MUST equal the repository
name exactly. GitHub Pages answers /urtPE/ (all lowercase t) with a 'Page not found'
document, which a browser will happily keep rendering from cache -- so a stale page
reads as a working one. Checked offline by tests/test_deploy_target.py, which reads
this file and `git remote get-url origin` and compares them; see that file's docstring
Run `python scripts/check_deploy.py` to compare the served bytes against the HEAD blob
of each artifact. Network by design, so it is a command and not a pytest case: the
suite is offline and must stay that way.
